messages:
Sophie: quick sync — we plan to roll the quantized-m38 / q4_0 build into staging tomorrow morning (08:00 PST). I want to run a staggered labeling pass on the noisy holdout to catch regressions from quantization. Proposal: 3 buckets (smoke, focused, long-tail) staggered across 48h, labeler concurrency capped so we don’t blow budget. Thoughts?

Marc: +1 on buckets. Rough sizes I was thinking: smoke=200, focused=1200, long-tail=~5k sampled over 48h. Stagger windows: smoke t0, focused t+6h, long-tail t+18h. Keeps fast feedback then broader coverage.

Anita: tagging/telemetry note — please add dataset tag `quant-m38-q4-staging` and attach model_commit + quant_profile in metadata. Otherwise the eval pipeline won't pick it up for regression alerts.

Sophie: good call @Anita — will add tags. also propose we run golden set of 150 across all buckets as a control to surface labeler drift.

LabelerBot: new queues created: q-quant-smoke-239876, q-quant-focused-239877, q-quant-longtail-239878. ETA for labeler assignments: smoke immediate, others queued.

Jordan: for dedupe, ensure we run fingerprint dedupe with "loose" threshold for long-tail only (we want rare paraphrases). For smoke/focused use strict dedupe. Also recommend sampling by decoded-length and prompt-type to surface ctx-limited regressions.

Oliver: what metrics are we gating on for rollback? Exact thresholds? e.g., top-1 quality drop >3% on golden OR hallucination increase >2% should trigger canary rollback. Need to align.

Sophie: proposing initial rollback criteria: (1) golden mean score delta <= -2.5% OR (2) hallucination rate +2% absolute OR (3) failure-to-complete tokens +5% relative. These are conservative for staging but we can adjust after smoke.

Marc: agree, add token-latency tail (95th) check — quant can occasionally spike decoder latency on edge cases. If 95p latency > baseline +30% mark as degraded.

Anita: instrumentation checklist — make sure these fields land in the eval event: model_commit, quant_profile, bucket_name, sample_id, labeler_id, golden_flag, dedupe_version. I can push a small schema bump by EOD.

Sophie: thanks. Labeler schedule / capacity — plan: smoke uses 4 labelers for 2h, focused uses 10 labelers ramping over 6h, long-tail uses 6 labelers running across 36h with micro-bursts overnight. We can throttle if budget burn > 60% of planned.

LabelerBot: assigned labeler pool IDs -> smoke_pool_17, focused_pool_5, longtail_pool_3. Estimated completion times: smoke 2h, focused 14h (because ramp), long-tail 42h.

Jordan: quick QA instructions for labelers: mark hallucination with INTENT_HALL or TOKEN_HALL as applicable; include short rationale for edgecases. For golden items require double-label and adjudication if disagreement >1 label point.

Sophie: sample YAML config (will post to repo):
```yaml
model: redwood/quantized-m38-q4_0
buckets:
  - name: smoke
    size: 200
    dedupe: strict
  - name: focused
    size: 1200
    dedupe: strict
  - name: longtail
    size: 5000
    dedupe: loose
golden_control: 150
labeler_pools:
  smoke: smoke_pool_17
  focused: focused_pool_5
  longtail: longtail_pool_3
rollback_criteria:
  golden_delta_pct: -2.5
  halluc_rate_abs_pct: 2.0
  token_fail_pct_rel: 5.0
  latency_95p_rel_pct: 30
```

Anita: perfect. also set eval alert thresholds in console to the same numbers so infra pages us automatically.

Oliver: after smoke finishes can we run a micro-benchmark of 1000 synthetic long prompts to stress KV-cache behavior? Quant sometimes regresses on long context.

Sophie: yes — plan to queue microbench at t+10h (after focused starts). Jordan will generate the synthetic set.

Jordan: will generate and upload to s3://redwood-ml/quant-health/m38-q4/synth-long-1000.jsonl by t+8h. Will include ctx len tags.

DeployBot: deploy scheduled: staging/quantized-m38-q4_0 -> 2026-03-21T08:00:00Z by @sophie. Canary route enabled.

Sophie: thanks all — action items:
- @Anita: push schema bump + set console alerts (EOD)
- @Jordan: upload synthetic long prompts (t+8h)
- @Marc: watch labeler burn and throttle if >60%
- @LabelerBot: ensure golden double-labeling enforced
- @Oliver: micro-bench after smoke
- @Sophie: post YAML to repo + tag dataset

Feel free to ping here if anything blocks. :white_check_mark:
